label: Split into tissues
purpose: Cut each tissue on a slide into its own image, masked to its outline
useWhen: A slide scan carrying several tissue sections or cores
Sections that interlace, so a box around one catches its neighbour
notWhen: One tissue with a region of interest: use Crop image
Brightfield (H&E): tissue must be brighter than the glass

notWhen.text: Image already segmented: labels stay on the source image

params.label: Tissue channels
params.tip: Channels that mark tissue; none uses every channel

params.label: Threshold
params.tip: Share of the automatic threshold above the glass; lower picks up fainter tissue

params.label: Neck cut-off
params.tip: Touching tissues split where the join is narrower than this share of either

params.label: Name
params.tip: Added to the image name with the tissue's number

params.label: Put in set
params.tip: Set the tissue images go into

params.label: Join gap (µm)
params.tip: Crumbs closer than this to a much larger tissue join it

params.label: Smallest tissue (mm²)
params.tip: Pieces smaller than this are left out

params.label: Edge margin (µm)
params.tip: Grows each outline so edges are kept; never into a neighbour
